 November 20, 2026: Central Louisiana Daily Briefing
 November 20, 2026 November 20, 2026 / JSLLC 
 Alexandria, Rapides Parish Government Offices to Close for Thanksgiving 
City of Alexandria and Rapides Parish Police Jury
 Alexandria city offices and Rapides Parish Police Jury offices will be closed Thursday and Friday, Nov. 26-27, for the Thanksgiving holiday. Alexandria’s holiday schedule includes City Hall, utility customer service offices and other municipal facilities. The Rapides Parish Clerk of Court also lists both days as holidays. Louisiana state government offices will observe Thanksgiving on Thursday and Acadian Day on Friday. Residents needing government services are encouraged to complete their business before the holiday or check with individual departments for emergency services and revised schedules.
 Alexandria Announces Thanksgiving Garbage Collection Changes 
City of Alexandria Sanitation Department
 The City of Alexandria has announced changes to residential garbage collection for Thanksgiving week. Regular collections are scheduled Monday and Tuesday, Nov. 23-24, with bulk pickup only Wednesday, Nov. 25. There will be no garbage collection Thursday or Friday, Nov. 26-27. The city plans to place temporary garbage trailers at four locations, including the Alexandria Youth Complex on Masonic Drive, Willow Glen River Road at Third Street, Oran Avenue at Lisa Street and the parking lot behind Smackin’ Mack’s on Metro Drive. The trailers are scheduled to remain available from Wednesday evening through Monday morning, Nov. 30.
 Rapides Parish Schools, Public Libraries Announce Thanksgiving Closures 
Rapides Parish School Board and Rapides Parish Library
 Rapides Parish public schools will be closed Monday through Friday, Nov. 23-27, for Thanksgiving break, according to the school district’s 2026-27 calendar. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, Nov. 30. Rapides Parish Library has separately announced that all library branches will be closed Thursday through Saturday, Nov. 26-28. Residents planning to visit libraries or schools during the holiday week should make arrangements around the announced schedules.
 Post Offices, Banks to Close Thanksgiving Day; Friday Schedules May Vary 
U.S. Postal Service and Federal Reserve
 Post offices and most banks will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, in observance of Thanksgiving. The U.S. Postal Service will suspend regular mail delivery, although certain premium delivery services may continue. Federal Reserve banking operations will also be closed Thursday, affecting the processing of some financial transactions. Friday, Nov. 27, is not a federal banking holiday, and normal postal operations are generally expected to resume. Individual banks and businesses may observe different Friday schedules. Customers are encouraged to verify hours before visiting.
 Alexandria Community Thanksgiving Dinner Serves Hundreds of Residents 
Community Thanksgiving Dinner Organizers
 Hundreds of Alexandria residents attended the second annual Community Thanksgiving Dinner Thursday, Nov. 19, at Greater Saint Lawrence Missionary Baptist Church on Cypress Street. The event brought together community partners to provide free holiday meals, clothing and other resources to families and individuals. Organizers worked to ensure residents facing financial difficulties or other challenges could enjoy a Thanksgiving meal and fellowship ahead of the holiday. The gathering was part of a community effort to assist neighbors during the holiday season.
 Rapides Parish Library Offers Tai Chi Program Saturday 
Rapides Parish Library
 Rapides Parish Library will host its Mindful Mornings: Tai Chi program Saturday, Nov. 21, at 9:30 a.m. at the Main Library in Alexandria. The program offers residents an opportunity to participate in a group activity focused on movement and mindfulness. The session is listed on the library’s public events calendar, with no advance registration required. Residents interested in attending can contact the Main Library for additional information.
